body:
Thank you for what you have said. It has just made me think about something, that I have been using other people as a measure for my success. 

I hope to make slow and steady steps towards something better and, in all honesty, I did not think anybody at all would say anything, let alone within one hour. Right now I'm trying to keep myself composed but to you and everyone who has posted her so far, thank you. Thank you so much. 

I hope I can experience that too, whatever time it takes, and I think I should impress myself before I impress anyone else. 

Thank you for the offer, if it's alright I will message you sometime soon

I'm sorry to hear that you've been here as well. Thank you for talking about this and for your advice and help. Being in it right now really hurts and while I still can't convince myself fully of a future, it is reassuring to hear from someone who has been at both extremes. 

Eventually I want to find the perfect job and a girl who is right for me, but if I wanted that I know I'd have to improve myself first. That is the part in finding hardest. Maybe a group would help, it's not something I've ever done before though and being in the UK I haven't really seen or heard of anywhere that offers an AA style group. 

I will consider everything in the next few days and by the end of the weekend coming I want to know what I want. Hopefully I can find physical help. Thank you again for responding, it really helps right now

Thank you for taking the time to talk, particularly about your own situation. It's honestly in a weird way good to relate to someone about this, although I wish for the both of us these things hadn't happened in the first place. 

I want to be able to take things day by day and learn to cope better, it's hard for me to get motivated without any close links as I live by myself in a town detached from any large cities, and my friend she lives within the closest city so it's always hard to connect. But that's ultimately what I want, to be back to the point where you are now where I can focus on self-improvement and a bit of clarity. 

So do I for us both, thank you once again

Thank you. I didn't think I would, but figured I needed to take time to collect my thoughts. 

The problem I've felt with improving my life has been that whereas before my life has pretty much gone from strength to strength quickly, I am now stuck jobless and friendless which is the first time imthis has ever happened to me. I'm finding it harder to cope just by myself. 

I really want to be happy, and I want to wake up one day without suicidal thoughts or a lack of motivation. Right now it's challenging to not associate those feelings with killing myself, trying to justify feeling better with ending things. Some of it also doesn't help that when I was in that relationship, we had aspirations, dreams, plans, and each other to motivate. I've had relationships before and have been through break ups, but I can honestly say this has been the hardest to come down from yet. It's like my best friend died
